scope.selection: All PENDING focus and spirit records; one record per (kind, id). Portraits and integrated targets excluded.
scope.count_discrepancy: The requested baseline mentioned 151 native AVI definitions. The current inventory actually contains 174 definitions sourced from AVI.txt; all 174 are covered, including Foundation and later military/dynastic focuses.
scope.source_fields: file is the repository-relative gameplay definition path, not a proposed image output. Name and description preserve inventory text except the two resolved localization aliases, whose original values are also retained.
scope.status: Semantic briefs only; no images generated, exported, integrated or visually approved.

art_direction.style: Painted HOI4/EaW object emblems with crisp material edges and a single dominant silhouette. Each record's brief defines its own composition; never reuse one generic branch badge.
art_direction.composition: One dominant physical object or unified object group, at most two subordinate motifs. Keep details legible at game size; simplify tiny diagrams rather than adding extra props. No surrounding decorative badge or repeated frame unless the actual object requires it.
art_direction.background: Transparent exterior; no opaque scene rectangle or invented flag background.
art_direction.anatomy: Object-only compositions: no humans, human hands, humanoid stand-ins, or invented character likenesses. Any military helmet must fit a griffon.
art_direction.documents: Never vacant paper, blank seals, or pseudo-text. Where a book, chart, budget, or register is essential, use a concrete diagram, map, tally, arithmetic counters, musical notes, or clearly structured visual entries. Do not render localization prose onto the icon. No invented crest on a seal.
art_direction.heraldry: Use a verified reference only where the individual brief explicitly needs it. Flags must retain their actual colors even outside the preferred palette. Default to non-heraldic objects. No arbitrary crowns, lilies, stars, eagle/griffon crests, or invented house symbols.

audit.duplicate_policy: Repeated names, mirrored descriptions, and localization aliases are not duplicate IDs. Keep separate briefs, including both hidden legacy invitation definitions.
audit.semantic_review: Reviewed inventory descriptions and parsed completion rewards/modifiers using the repository's existing Clausewitz parser read-only. Scripted-effect calls were inspected as effect references; no claim of exhaustive runtime simulation.
lore_hazards: Do not copy Cyanolisian, Aquileian or imperial heraldry into generic Verenian objects. Unified Verenia's official flag is crownless.
Charter cooperation, association, defence league, constitutional accession, and conquest have different sovereignty implications. No automatic annexation or forced allied command.
Rosaline and Montague's personal correspondence is not an imposed marriage, dowry, or automatic diplomatic mandate.
Grover can be a living minor, adult, dead, abroad, or unlocated. Household investigations must not invent an outcome, death, arrival, or guardianship.
Erie's restored-Empire transition and Avian's constitutional Herzland settlement are distinct routes; a temporary civilian commission carries no imperial title.
Zypressen's claim to the imperial throne precedes a separate coronation. Dependent crowns and allies retain powers not explicitly delegated; no universal annexation imagery.
The Foundation has sparse supplied lore. Use secure facilities, personnel equipment and research apparatus without importing franchise symbols.
Branch choice scenes must remain visually neutral between their possible outcomes; breach spirits must show coercion or imbalance rather than uncomplicated progress.
Native descriptions sometimes disagree with current rewards. Specific cases are annotated in lore_notes; no gameplay or inventory fixes were made.

records.name: Convene the House Council
records.description: It is a time of crisis. In the lands of the ailing Empire, unruly vassals connive secession, whilst the Emperor's health grows worse by the day. To the west, Aquileia teeters on the brink of another civil war. To the south, the expansionist Wingbardy and her allies hungrily eye their neighbours. House Avian is surrounded by enemies, and a new strategy is needed if the House is to survive the turbulent years to come.
records.brief: Three empty council chairs around a triangular table, with a border-threat map at its centre.

records.name: Go with Count Ehrenreich
records.description: Count Ehrenreich and his policy of armed neutrality is the way forward. Only through isolation will House Avian be safe from the madness outside its borders.
records.brief: A closed border gate braced by a service rifle, representing Ehrenreich's armed neutrality.

records.name: Go with Viceroy Joachim
records.description: Viceroy Joachim and his ideal of a union between the Three Great Houses of the Griffonian Heartlands is the path to Avian greatness, and protection from the great powers that would seek to engulf us.
records.brief: Three separate bridge spans meeting at a central pier, Joachim's proposed union between the Houses.

records.name: Proclamation of Avian Neutrality
records.description: Whilst House Avian has remained neutral and aloof from any conflicts since its secession from the Empire, its neutrality has never been officially acknowledged. Declaring our intention to remain neutral in future conflicts will hopefully insulate us from the worst of the wars to come.
records.brief: An upright sheathed sword beside a closed frontier barrier and a plain ivory signal pennant.

records.name: Avian Intergigantes
records.description: House Avian sits at the epicentre between three belligerent nations - the Empire, Aquileia, and Wingbardy. Trapped between the giants, House Avian must unite with its fellow Houses or perish.
records.brief: Three small joined watchtowers enclosed between three looming unmarked fortress walls; the Houses shelter together.

records.name: Pursue True Neutrality
records.description: The feuding houses of Eyrie and Erie will never be able to put aside their differences, even to face a common foe. Like it or not, House Avian will have to go it alone; there is no point in bedding a corpse, even if there are two of them.
records.brief: A single fortified gate with its drawbridge raised and two unused approach roads ending outside.

records.name: Overtures to House Erie
records.description: We lack a permanent representative within the court of House Erie, and any communication between House Avian and one of our officials is terribly slow. By establishing an embassy we will solve both problems in a single stroke.
records.brief: An embassy doorway with a diplomatic dispatch case; copy the Erie flag exactly from its reference.

records.name: Overtures to House Eyrie
records.description: Communication with House Eyrie, despite being neighbours, is problematic even at the best of times. Installing a diplomat from our house will ease these issues and open up new diplomatic options with House Eyrie.
records.brief: A court messenger bell beside an embassy letterbox; copy the Eyrie flag exactly from its reference.

records.name: Pursue Economic Cooperation
records.description: Alone, our economic might is paltry compared to those of larger nations. Only by forming new trade and economic deals between our houses will we stand to make an impression in the global stage.
records.brief: Three loaded trade wagons converging on one weighing station, with no national insignia.

records.name: Promote Inter-House Fraternisation
records.description: The once Great Houses of the Griffon Heartlands have long since fallen apart into tribalist factionalism that has only served to drive a wedge between our people. We are all griffons, and we are all griffons of the realms of the Three Houses.
records.brief: Three differently shaped drinking cups sharing a single serving tray at a common table.

records.name: Student Exchange Program
records.description: Looking closely at the different schools between the three houses, one is hard-pressed to find significant differences in the way that we teach and what our chicks learn. A way to nip the inter-house disdain would be to show our students just how similar we all are.
records.brief: Two school satchels exchanging places across a small bridge, an illustrated lesson book between them.

records.name: Three Houses Corporation
records.description: Previously one of the better examples of our houses' capacity to cooperate, the Three Houses Corporation can expand its scope into research and development if we encourage further investments from all three houses.
records.brief: A precision lathe backed by three investment coin stacks and a laboratory measuring instrument.

records.name: Relax Citizenship Requirements
records.description: Ancient Heartlands families have been forced apart due to the stringent citizenship requirements and travel permits between the houses' territories. Loosening some of these restrictions is not only morally the right thing, but a pragmatic move on having our people warm up to the idea of a single realm of the Three Houses.
records.brief: An unlocked passport barrier above two travel cases, its formerly separated lanes now joined.

records.name: Scientific Exchange Program
records.description: Each of the Three Houses have had their own research programmes that diverged and would often be contrary to the betterment of the Heartlands themselves. By allowing free movements of scientists and unifying our efforts, the Heartlands can begin to form a new hub of scholarly endeavours in Griffonia.
records.brief: A travelling instrument case opened beside a microscope and a shared circuit diagram.

records.name: Common Market Agreement
records.description: With successful deals between the Three Houses bringing in wealth to every griffon, it only stands to reason that further economic integration will allow for greater prosperity among the Houses.
records.brief: Three market awnings joined over one merchant scale, with the old toll chain laid aside.

records.name: Inter-House Security Cooperation
records.description: We stand alone against the menace around our realms. Once the storm washes over our lands, the Houses must heed the call to stand as one.
records.brief: Three interlocking defensive shutters enclosing a watch bell, each retaining its own hinge.

records.name: Support the Tripartite College
records.description: With coalescing curriculums, there's no reason why we cannot form a single curriculum offered by a single college. A Tripartite College will further bolster a sense of unity among our generations and instil an identity not determined of the realm of the House they are from, but of our single inter-house entity.
records.brief: A three-wing college building around one open book bearing a geometric lesson diagram.

records.name: Ending the Rivalry
records.description: The feud between House Eire and House Eyrie have continually been a hindrance to a unified House Realm, and any hope to achieve that dream starts with an end to the rivalry. Let us begin the arduous process, for a better future for our people.
records.brief: Two notched duelling blades lowered across a removed frontier chain.

records.name: The Annual Hunting Trip
records.description: The time is upon us: the yearly hunting trip where most of the House Avian nobles shall leave for the countryside. With all of the doom and gloom that permeates the courts, it is refreshing for the members of said courts to unwind and get in touch with their predator side. Hunting never got anyone killed, anyways.
records.brief: A hunting horn and sporting rifle resting beside autumn branches; no dead hunter or invented accident.
records.lore_notes: The ironic hunting description does not establish a particular death in this focus; no invented victim or murder scene.

records.name: Weekly Luncheons
records.description: The best way for rivals to get over their feud is to force them to see and treat each other as equals. House Avian can arrange for weekly lunches for members of both House Eire and House Eyrie. The first few events will be messy, but who knows? At least everyone will have a laugh.
records.brief: Two opposed place settings brought together around a shared loaf and a small luncheon bell.

records.name: The Winterfest Ball
records.description: The Winterfest Ball is a House Erie tradition, and has never seen a single member of House Eyrie attend since the start of their bloody rivalry. With proper preparations, we can break this sad streak and demonstrate just how far the two houses have come in mending their relationship.
records.brief: A winter evergreen sprig above two linked ballroom dance cards bearing matching musical-note motifs.

records.name: The Scion Swap
records.description: Tensions have diminished between House Erie and House Eyrie, but there are many that are sceptical of a lasting peace. What better way to tie the two houses together via the exchange of two highborn noble scions? Montague Eyrie, Earl of Verenia, and Lady Rosaline Erie of Bantry have demonstrated an interest in this exchange.
records.brief: Two noble travel trunks facing opposite directions across an open gate; no wedding rings or coerced marriage.
records.lore_notes: Rosaline and Montague are autonomous characters; exchange and correspondence do not establish a forced marriage.

records.name: Eyrie-Erie Treaty of Friendship
records.description: Bread was broken and shared, love has bloomed, and plenty of laughs were had between House Erie and House Eyrie. Were one to see these two houses interact without knowing their history, they would find it difficult to believe that they were ever at each other's throats. It is time to declare the Eyrie-Erie feud as officially over.
records.brief: Two sheathed ancestral swords tied together with a peace ribbon over a repaired boundary stone.

records.name: The Intergigantes Tripartite
records.description: With no further bad blood blocking the way, House Avian can finally set about to uniting the House Realms with an alliance that shall last forever or until the last griffon of the realms breathes their last. May our friendship last for decades!
records.brief: Three load-bearing columns supporting one defensive lintel, a durable alliance rather than a merged state.

records.name: A Unified Intelligence Agency
records.description: The spy networks of both Eyrie and Erie need to be unified along side House Avian's intelligence agency in order to keep watch over external and internal affairs. Even with our current Tripartite's ability to fend itself off from other powers, we must make sure we are able to detect any future threats through unified cohesian within our intelligence agency.
records.brief: Three cable reels feeding a single listening receiver and a lens over a plotted surveillance network.

records.name: Annual Military Exercises
records.description: We should work with the other Houses to pursue full military cohesion through annual military exercises. Even though our past disunity brought about different military strategies, annual military exercises between all houses can bring about more needed experience and ability to change in order to fight any future wars.
records.brief: Three sets of exercise markers advancing together across a training sand table.

records.name: A Unified Railroad Network
records.description: Each House's rail network is mainly internal and not connected with another. This needs to be fixed to bring about more unified commerce as well as faster military movement in case one of the Triparte members is attacked. Let's bring our rail together.
records.brief: Three railway tracks converging through a newly fitted junction switch.

records.name: Interhouses Technological Cooperation
records.description: The Houses have been divided technologically for too long. We need scientists from each of the houses to be able to coordinate together to research new scientific breakthroughs that can further help our houses along in modernizing our Pact.
records.brief: Three laboratory instruments arranged around one illuminated electrical circuit.

records.name: Prepare Constitutional Integration
records.description: The common markets, colleges and transport agreements have given Intergigantes practical weight. Commission a constitutional settlement to carry this cooperation towards one Verenia. Katrina will open the charter negotiations, test the first common institutions and then bring the question of a united government before a constituent convention. The Houses' authority must pass through agreed laws and ratification.
records.brief: An unassembled constitutional binding with three fitted clasps beside a convention lectern; union is still being negotiated.

records.name: The Northern Defense Line
records.description: To the north lay the revanchist Empire and the Republic. Both will have designs on our land. We must be prepared.
records.brief: A northern-facing bunker embrasure above a compass with its north point picked out in cobalt.

records.name: The Southern Defense Line
records.description: To the south lay Wingbardy and her allies. They have already demonstrated their desire for expansion. We will be ready to meet them.
records.brief: A southward gun casemate above a compass with its south point picked out in crimson.

records.name: The Southeast Defense Line
records.description: To the Southeast is where the victor of the Prywhen Civil War is. They may come for us, and we must be ready for them.
records.brief: A southeast-facing angled earthwork with a compass needle pointing southeast and a field telescope.

records.name: The Western Defense Line
records.description: To the west lay Aquileia, and they too have shown their desire to absorb the rest of Griffonia; they shall meet our walls and be halted by them.
records.brief: A westward stone defensive wall with an iron observation slit and a west-pointing compass.

records.name: Form the Tripartite Legion
records.description: After years of division, feuding, hostility, and animosity between House Eyrie and House Erie, we as House Avian have been able put it all aside to work together. Not just work together, but we also have become brothers with the other houses during this turbulent period. Now we will lead both houses into a new future of security and order in which we can further our gains and help our houses prosper further.
records.brief: Three infantry rifles standing in one service rack above a common ammunition chest.

records.name: A Common Military Leadership
records.description: It's time we unite our military leadership with the other houses and form a new chain of command under House Avian. The other houses will have their own chains of command but it will remain under our direction and guiding claw to make sure military coordination is successful.
records.brief: A central command telephone linking three subordinate field receivers; no imperial regalia.

records.name: The Second Winterfest Ball
records.description: After the success of the first Winterfest Ball, we should make an even bigger one in which all houses are already included, with more food, drink, music, as well as more grand speeches to showcase the common ground that every house has with each other. It's time we make our unity a true tradition to stand the test of time.
records.brief: A large three-branched candelabrum over a festive punch bowl and evergreen garland.

records.name: Support Local Companies
records.description: Our House needs to support more local companies in order for our economy to grow. Without healthy companies to keep employment high, as well as exports to keep being moved out, our economy will fall prey to foreign influences from both the Imperials, Aquileians, and even Skyfall.
records.brief: A small workshop storefront with an open strongbox supplying its tool bench.

records.name: Indigenous Manufactories
records.description: More indigenous_manufactories will not only increase employment, but also strengthen factory output for the many guns and shells needed to equip our growing military. It's time we encourage our own homegrown factories.
records.brief: A locally built civilian factory press beside a homegrown workshop tool rack and a metal stock bin.
records.lore_notes: Prose mentions guns and shells, but construction reward is a civilian industrial_complex. Use general local manufacturing, not a dedicated arms factory.

records.name: Agricultural Sustainability
records.description: We need to make sure our food supply is secure without needing to rely as much on trade. When war comes, a hungry populace will be a weak and weary populace.
records.brief: A full grain silo above a carefully fenced crop plot, a reserve sack at its foot.

records.name: Avian Protectionism
records.description: Our industry and economy is still relatively and developing. We should not free our trade to the world at this point, lest we have companies putting our fellow griffons out of business. Let's put some tariffs on goods to protect our populace.
records.brief: A customs gate sheltering a local workshop while an imported cargo crate waits outside.

records.name: Consolidate Avian Industry
records.description: Avian industry is too decentralized at this current point. Artisanry is still dominant in our less developed lands. We should have local industries starting to move and consolidate them in order for manufacturing to become more efficient.
records.brief: Two small workbenches feeding one larger belt-driven factory machine.

records.name: Everygriff a Farmer
records.description: Even as our country becomes more industrialized, we should still encourage more farming in order to achieve our goals of agricultural self-sufficiency. Let's start agricultural education farmers to make sure everygriff knows how to do basic farming.
records.brief: A seed tray beside a hoe and an illustrated sowing chart, practical farming instruction.

records.name: Material Self-sufficiency
records.description: We also need to be self-sufficient in raw materials. We should work towards becoming much more effective in conserving needed raw materials as well as producing them more efficiently as to prevent waste for our society to survive.
records.brief: A scrap-metal basket feeding a compact smelting crucible, reusable offcuts visible beside it.

records.name: Localised Manufacturing Standards
records.description: Manufacturing standards should not be expected to be perfect with how decentralized the houses are, but we should enforce the provinces to have local manufacturing standards to help produce more guns from each house.
records.brief: A rifle component passing through a go/no-go gauge beside matching finished parts.

approved_visual_override.subject: A workshop gauge board with three matching steel cylinders fitted into round sockets. Grey precision steel and muted green enamel.
approved_visual_override.note: Approved neutral artwork supersedes the prior visual composition only; original description, target pins and gameplay are unchanged.

records.name: Cooperative Farms
records.description: With our farmer programs becoming successful, we should encourage cooperatives to be able to have our farms be more self-sustaining and more resistant to economic fluctuations. These cooperatives will not only strengthen our food production but the camraderie our fellow griffs have with each other.
records.brief: A shared threshing machine at the junction of three cultivated strips.

records.name: State-Capital Alliance
records.description: It is time we need to align the directions of our state with the interests of capitalists. We need to make sure the forces of capital are on the same page as us in regards to our security, so we will work to assist these forces with their wealth while they work to help us consolidate our nation.
records.brief: A treasury strongbox linked by a drive belt to a private factory flywheel.

records.name: Infrastructure Modernisation
records.description: Our infrastructure is still haphazard and poor. It's unacceptable that our country still relies so much on dirt roads for trade. We must revamp our infrastructure and connect every town and city to modern and improved roads in order for our house to further flourish.
records.brief: A newly surfaced road crossing a stone culvert, with a surveyor's level beside it.

records.name: A Closed Agro-ecosystem
records.description: We need to keep our farmers protected and secure from the harmfulness of industrialization. Even with the necessity of industry, farmers should not be hampered by companies wishing to control it. We will enact protection laws to make sure farmers remain safe from industry.
records.brief: A farm plot enclosed by a protective fence, with factory machinery kept outside its boundary.

records.name: Splendid Isolation
records.description: Our nation does not need to get involved in the chaos of Griffonian international politics as that could entangle house Avian in wars it does not need to fight and will not gain from. Our splendid isolation will keep our people at peace and prosperity.
records.brief: A quiet shuttered border lodge with an intact grain basket inside its protective wall.

records.name: Militarised Society
records.description: Even with our relative isolation from major Griffonian politics, we can never be too prepared in case of various powers wanting to eat our country whole and subjugate our people. All citizens will receive some form of basic training when they are of early adult age and be battle ready in case of invaders.
records.brief: A household tool rack paired with a training rifle and a drill whistle.

records.name: Fortify the Borders
records.description: We need to put more emphasis on our borders in order to protect against any of our possible rivals. We will most likely be less numerous and outgunned. So to combat this, we need more fencing, more watchtowers, and more bunkers to keep our country safe.
records.brief: A border watchtower joined to a low bunker by barbed wire.

records.name: Mandatory Military Service
records.description: Every able-bodied adult griffon must be expected to serve for a number of years in order to bolster our ranks and help secure our borders. With all the possible invaders we have on all sides, House Avian must stand strong and make sure we have enough griffons to deter majors from simply attacking us without mutual bloodshed.
records.brief: A service kit laid over a calendar marked with repeated muster dots.

records.name: Weekly Rifle Practice
records.description: Every soldier should at least practice their accuracy and precision once a week with their rifles. This weekly practice will ensure our soldiers will be able to shoot properly in case of war.
records.brief: A rifle sight aligned on a tightly grouped practice target, a weekly tally strip beneath.

records.name: Western Defenses
records.description: We must construct a line of fortresses along the western border in case of attack from either smaller nations like Flowena, or larger ones like Aquileia. These defenses will make them think twice before attacking us so hastily
records.brief: A west-facing fortress gun behind a stepped concrete firing wall.

records.name: Eastern Defenses
records.description: We must construct a line of fortresses along the eastern border in case of attack from either smaller nations like House Erie, or larger ones like the looming Griffonian Empire. Our defense will be vital since we have a larger border with Herzland.
records.brief: A long eastern trench line anchored by two observation towers, a compass showing east.

records.name: Guns for Gilda
records.description: We have too many old guns. In the age of modern war, we need to break down these old models and make the newest of rifles in order to have our troops better equipped in any possible firefight with any attackers.
records.brief: A worn rifle dismantled beside a newly machined bolt-action replacement.

approved_visual_override.subject: An old rusted gear beside a clean replacement gear in a small wooden parts tray. Iron, walnut and subdued green enamel. Symbol of equipment renewal.
approved_visual_override.note: Approved neutral artwork supersedes the prior visual composition only; original description, target pins and gameplay are unchanged.

records.name: Muskets for Magda
records.description: There is not enough guns in our stockpile. Our troops have been underequipped for so long. There will be a new initiative to make sure we acquire as many guns as possible, even if they are of poorer quality.
records.brief: A crowded emergency arms crate containing crude melee weapons and old muskets; equipment quantity rather than modern rifles.
records.lore_notes: Name and prose discuss guns, but the effect adds 3500 melee_equipment_1. Emphasise an emergency mixed low-grade arms stock; do not imply modern rifle procurement.

records.name: Hidden Bunkers
records.description: We should lay some surprises for any possible invaders and put hidden bunkers filled with machine gun nests throughout our roads and path ways. These spots will be perfect for both ambush and harrassment
records.brief: A concealed machine-gun embrasure beneath a turf-covered mound beside a narrow road.

records.name: The Ehrenreich Redoubt
records.description: Our capital is the sacred center of power within our House. We must make some the most impregnable of modern walls and fences, as well as the most planned of machine gun nests in order to truly secure our capital from danger because if the capital is lost, our country will be lost in a short time.
records.brief: A concentric capital redoubt with interlocking machine-gun apertures and reinforced gates.

records.name: A Decentralised Arsenal
records.description: There is no guarantee the enemy won't break our lines. In that scenario, we will make sure our arsenal is spread out enough so troops will be able to have access weapons in the case they are cut off, where ever they are.
records.brief: Three small ammunition caches separated by terrain, each with a rifle crate under cover.

records.name: The Avian Reservist System
records.description: It's time we establish a new reservist system where we will have a core amount of reserve troops to call up in case we go to war. We should have enough power to mount a more capable defense once we implement the new system.
records.brief: A reserve kit chest opened beneath a muster bell, civilian tools resting alongside.

records.name: Das Raubvogel
records.description: The Birds of Prey, an organization set up to not only ambush enemy lines, but to harrass and destroy supply lines. These partisan special forces will bring Tartarus to any enemy that is occupying out soil.
records.brief: A severed occupation supply rail beside concealed wire cutters and a partisan field radio.

records.name: Avian Anti-air
records.description: The current state of our air defenses is pitiful. This nation needs to focus more on air defense research in order to combat enemy bombers. We will not have the planes to win so let's encourage more anti-air.
records.brief: An elevated anti-aircraft gun with a rangefinder aimed above a small rooftop.

records.name: House Avian Stands Strong
records.description: Let it be known, that House Avian, as one of the oldest houses of Griffonia, will never bow to any foreign power, whether of Imperial power or Aquileian power. We will not simply surrender or give in. We will fight to the last, until we can't fight anymore.
records.brief: A scarred but upright Avian gate retaining the exact native flag, rubble below its intact lintel.

records.name: Avian Military Act
records.description: The enaction of this act will allow our House to be able to reform the military from a group of rabble militia, into a proper professional army that is prepared for the upcoming future. We must learn new tactics and doctrines to be of upmost capability.
records.brief: A disordered militia kit reorganised into a fitted service chest beside a drill whistle.

records.name: Avian Officer Academy
records.description: A new generation of officers is ready to be made and used for the full capabilities of the military. We should encourage as much talented officers as possible to rise the ranks and effectively strengthen our military.
records.brief: An officer's map board with dividers and a classroom lectern, no decorative rank invention.

records.name: Liberalise the Officer Corps
records.description: The current Officer Corps is filled with outdated ideas and old blood. It's time we open up the Officer Corps to new and modern ideas. Fresh officers will be able to bring new concepts and new skills to help strengthen the military leadership.
records.brief: An academy gate opened beside an examination slate and an unadorned officer's baton.

records.name: Aristocratic Officers
records.description: Our current Officer Corps is fine. We don't need commoners entering the Academy and tainting it with idiocy. If anything, having aristocrats ensures our army remains in the claws of experienced leaders that know the rules of war.
records.brief: A closed academy gate with an heirloom officer's sword and a reserved velvet chair.

records.name: Recruit Commoner Generals
records.description: We need to open up the ability to be a general to commoners as well. There is plenty of younger minds ready to lead and defend this country. We just need to make things easier for them.
records.brief: A workshop apron laid beside a command baton and a completed geometric tactical exercise.

records.name: Favour House Retainers
records.description: Our current House retainers will be will suited to being good generals in the future. They will already have better starting experience than any peasant or lower class merchant wanting to join the army.
records.brief: A household service key crossing an old campaign sword above a military map case.

records.name: A Citizen's Milita Army
records.description: Even if it will take longer for peasant citizens to be trained, as well as less organized, it is much superior to have more griffons being able to wield guns than less, even with the limited griffonpower we have.
records.brief: Several mismatched civilian satchels hung beneath a communal rifle rack.

records.name: A Professional Standing Army
records.description: Discipline is key to a functioning army. We cannot rely on rabble to fight our wars. Thus, we need to make sure the Avian military has well-trained regulars prepared for intense combat on all sides.
records.brief: One precisely packed field kit beside a polished service rifle and regulation cartridge boxes.

records.name: Weapons Research
records.description: We need better rifles and better bullets in order to catch up with our rivals. So let's research weapons that any soldier can be proud of.
records.brief: A rifle bolt and cartridge cross-section under a gunsmith's measuring caliper.

approved_visual_override.subject: A precision micrometer measuring a plain steel cylinder beside a small technical notebook with a simple circle diagram. Blued steel, ivory paper and walnut.
approved_visual_override.note: Approved neutral artwork supersedes the prior visual composition only; original description, target pins and gameplay are unchanged.

records.name: Artillery Development
records.description: Our artillery is outdated. We must research better barrels and better ammunition in order to rain Tartarus on our enemies.
records.brief: A cutaway artillery barrel beside an improved shell and a rifling gauge.

records.name: Research Support Weapons
records.description: Every company needs support equipment. Whether it's trench equipment to make better trenches, or recon equipment to scout enemy positions. Our infantry need all the help they can get.
records.brief: An entrenching shovel and binoculars laid across a compact support-equipment crate.

records.name: Favour Traditional Doctrines
records.description: Why trust new contraptions that have barely fought in the most recent of wars versus the tried and true. Knights have always been reliable and we must make sure to accomodate and adapt with what we already have.
records.brief: A griffon-fitted plate helmet and knightly lance above a repairable armour joint.

records.name: Favour Modern Doctrines
records.description: Knights are outdated, a relic of the past. We need to move forward and focus on motorization of our army. The faster our army can move, the faster they can respond to crisis.
records.brief: A military transport truck with a road wheel prominent, an infantry kit on its cargo bed.

records.name: Local Tank Production
records.description: We should rely on the ingenious minds of our researchers in order to develop tanks faster and catch up. We cannot be too reliant on foreign powers for help.
records.brief: A tank turret in a domestic assembly jig with a rivet tool beside it.

approved_visual_override.subject: A short tracked vehicle undercarriage with three road wheels beneath a factory lifting hook. No vehicle body or armament. Dull olive metal, dark rubber, grey steel.
approved_visual_override.note: Approved neutral artwork supersedes the prior visual composition only; original description, target pins and gameplay are unchanged.

records.name: Foreign Tank Licenses
records.description: It would be foolish not to look at the tanks of our rivals and possibly learn and take bits from their designs in order to increase our own. Our tank industry is at its infancy anyways.
records.brief: A foreign tank blueprint showing real component diagrams beneath a local engineer's caliper.

approved_visual_override.subject: A rolled engineering drawing of a road wheel and suspension spring held with a plain red wax seal. Pale blue paper, grey metal, muted burgundy wax.
approved_visual_override.note: Approved neutral artwork supersedes the prior visual composition only; original description, target pins and gameplay are unchanged.

records.name: Special Forces Effort
records.description: In the modern era of warfare, we cannot rely on purely infantry and knights, we need specialized infantry fighting in the air, sea, and mountains. More research needs to be allocated for that.
records.brief: A folded parachute, mountain piton and compact landing boat arranged as three specialist disciplines.

records.name: Military Radio Direction Ranging
records.description: Avian's military needs to incorporate radios. If we have radios in our entire military, we will be able to position and reinforce much faster than before.
records.brief: A compact radio-direction-finding aerial above a radar scope and plotting compass, matching the radar research and station reward.
records.lore_notes: The localized title and effects concern radar, including radar_tech bonuses and radar_station construction, despite the prose's general radio language.

records.name: Doctrinal Advancement
records.description: Whichever path we chosen, we need to refine our military doctrine in order to make our military not only the fighting force we made it to be, but an efficient one at what it does.
records.brief: A sand-table manoeuvre with unit blocks moving along a single coordinated attack route.

records.name: Form the Avian Aviation Auxiliary
records.description: The air is the soul of a griffon. We cannot let our skies become dominated by the enemy or we could get pummeled to dust by their bombers. We must rapidly advance fighter development to properly combat this and make sure we achieve air superiority.
records.brief: A single-engine interceptor lifting above a small auxiliary hangar.

records.name: CAS Effort
records.description: We will need better ground support in order for our forces to protect our country better. Let's make sure our air support gets the upgrades it needs.
records.brief: A low-flying ground-attack aircraft with a visible bomb rack above a marked ground position.

records.name: Build Military Airstrips
records.description: We will create new airstrips for our burgeoning air auxiliary. Our planes will need as much room for our pilots to leave their hangars.
records.brief: A compact paved runway with edge lamps and a windsock.

records.name: Tactical Bomber Effort
records.description: Our air auxiliary will get the best tactical bombers it needs to be able to give our air wings in edge in bombing our enemies factories and roads.
records.brief: A twin-engine tactical bomber with its bomb bay visible over a rail-junction diagram.

records.name: Instate the Avian Air Assault Academy
records.description: The Avian Air Assault Academy will be formed in order to create a new generation of paratroopers capable of effectively landing behind enemy lines. Their skill will make Avian proud.
records.brief: An open training parachute suspending an equipment bundle beside an academy jump platform.

records.name: Heavy Fighter Effort
records.description: It's not enough to have excellent fighters for claiming air superiority. Some bombers are far above normal range. We will need heavier fighters to combat them and protect our cities from harm.
records.brief: A twin-engine heavy interceptor climbing toward a distant bomber silhouette.

records.name: Develop an Aerial Doctrine
records.description: Let's develop an aerial doctrine that can make our air auxiliary into a more effective air force. Once that is organized and prepared to fight in its own way.
records.brief: Aerial formation models mounted above a flight-planning board with intersecting course lines.

records.name: Lishill Fighter Production Plant
records.description: After clearing the land needed for this project. We can now create the fighter production plant in order to be able to have more fighters not only replenish our wings but create more wings.
records.brief: A fighter fuselage on a factory assembly cradle beneath an overhead hoist.

records.name: Hallhaus Radar Station
records.description: A radar station will be constructed to better assist our air wings in securing air superiority over our country. Without Radar, air superiority is less than possible.
records.brief: A lattice radar aerial turning above a compact Hallhaus station roof.

records.name: Expand Plane Production
records.description: More planes must be produced to expand our air force! The assembly plants will have more lines in order to make production costs cheaper for our fighter planes.
records.brief: Two successive aircraft fuselages on parallel production tracks beside a propeller rack.

records.name: Assert Ascendant Avian Aviation Ability
records.description: The time has come for Avian to assert its dominance over the skies. Possessing greater speeds then regular engines. Jets and rockets will certainty be the future of aviation. We must continue to prove our aviation ability by adopting these new technologies.
records.brief: A cutaway jet turbine beside a small rocket test stand; depict technological research, not a completed missile arsenal.

records.name: Acknowledge Advanced Aerial Accomplishments
records.description: Despite our small size. We have come to a forefrot of aviation advancement and skill. Griffons all over Griffonia know we have the best aircraft and our pilots are some of the best trained in the world. Should any foreign power try to strike us, they will find the Avian Airforce is more then capable of defending Avian.
records.brief: A polished fighter in level flight above pilot goggles and a precise flight-performance chart.

records.name: Acknowledge Social Problems
records.description: The collapse of imperial authority has not been kind to Avian. Landlocked and without resources, our economy has stagnated. And while the Avian dynasty held on, our people impoverished itself. Let us end the masquerade.
records.brief: A worn empty household purse beside a cracked cooking pot and a shuttered workshop.

records.name: Establish the Treasury
records.description: The imperial economic collapse threw the avian finances into utter chaos. A special commission known as the Treasury, or Cour des Comptes, will be set up to reorganize our tax collection and budget oversight in the flowenan tradition.
records.brief: A treasury counting desk with coin trays and an abacus balancing two unequal columns.

records.name: Strengthen the Avian Livre
records.description: When Avian declared independence, a new avian livre was created. However, political instability and mismanagement ruined the value of the new currency. This has only increased our problems due to how much our country relies on import. We shall raise our interest rates and rationalize our fiscal codes to strengthen the Livre.
records.brief: An Avian livre coin stack steadied by a calibrated balance and a bank vault door.

records.name: Found the Avian Chamber of Commerce
records.description: Avian economic policies remain those of a pre-industrial time but gone are the times of the feudal obligations. We must consolidate our economic forces and further our interests at home and abroad with a clear strategy. We shall set up a Chamber of Commerce to do just that.
records.brief: A commercial meeting table centred on a merchant scale with trade crates at its foot.

records.name: Language-neutral Inscriptions
records.description: Avian is not culturally united and our linguistic controversies slipped into the monetary debates. Many took offense at the wording used on our banknotes and coin and some stores and citizens even reject its use, thinking that they are foreign-made counterfeit. We will remedy to it by removing words requiring translation altogether.
records.brief: A coin and banknote carrying simple geometric denominations and numerals only, no language or invented arms.

records.name: A Commoners' Chamber
records.description: The creation of our Chamber of Commerce is well under way but due to old regulations, many commoners are still barred from joining it. By restricting participation in the Chamber on the basis of birth rather than merit, we are cutting ourselves from many competent and eager griffs. It is high time to remedy this and include the commoners into our plans!
records.brief: An open chamber doorway admitting a tradesgriffon's tool case to the meeting table.

records.name: An Aristocratic Chamber
records.description: The creation of our Chamber of Commerce has seen little participation from those who hold much of our wealth: the nobility. Avian gentlegriffs have been reluctant to join this innovative institution. We will make the Chamber an exclusive group and break this inertia by appealing to their pride. True meritocracy will have to wait.
records.brief: A velvet meeting chair behind a closed chamber rail, with a substantial private strongbox.

records.name: The Linguistic Divide
records.description: Times have changed. A country cannot be defined by the language of it's nobles anymore, no matter how much we dislike this fact. We must evolve with the times and adapt if we wish to survive in this age. And to survive and thrive, we must address the linguistic issue.
records.brief: Two differently bound dictionaries separated by a cracked school slate.

records.name: Favour Aquileian
records.description: The answer to our problem is simple - all within our realm should embrace the great tongue of the Aquileians. While we are on a cultural and linguistic border, we cannot deny the fact that we have been part of the Aquileian cultural and political sphere for most of our history. We must respect the heritage of our great house. The Aquileian language is our past and it will be our future.
records.brief: An Aquileian-language reader selected from a pair of books, marked by a cobalt bookmark; no lilies.

records.name: Linguistic Dual Hegemony
records.description: Despite what many claim, the two languages of our realm are not out weakness, it's one of our great strengths! It is proof that House Avian is something greater than just an extension of the Aquileian or the Heartlander sphere. We are a bridge between two great cultures and it is our duty to preserve this. While many believe it to be impossible, we will thrive as a bilingual state.
records.brief: Two equally sized dictionaries supporting one classroom lamp, equal visual weight.

records.name: Favour Griffish
records.description: The answer to our problem is simple - all within our realm should embrace the great tongue of the Herzlanders. The Griffonian Empire may have been shattered, but the Heartlands are still the beating heart of Griffonia. While it is indeed true that historically we were Aquileian, we should look at the future, not the past. And the future lies in the Heartlands.
records.brief: A Griffish-language reader selected beside a Heartlands route diagram; no imperial crown.

records.name: Codify the Aquileian Dialect
records.description: With the preparations done, new institutions of learning constructed and educators trained, the time to truly embrace our choice has come. From now on all schools and institutions of learning will only teach in the Aquileian language. While it might be a long and difficult task of returning back to the Aquileian cultural sphere, it's a necessary task to survive.
records.brief: A classroom printing block beside an Aquileian reader with a concrete illustrated lesson.

records.name: Local Dialects
records.description: Despite the minute size of our realm, parts of our populace speak in a dozen dialects. While some are fearful that allowing these languages to exist will only divide our country, such claims are simply absurd. We will not destroy this proof of our greatness and uniqueness because some are afraid of anything they dislike. We will preserve these languages and dialects and encourage their growth.
records.brief: Several small dialect notebooks fanned around a recording horn, each with distinct geometric cover marks.

records.name: Codify the Imperial Dialect
records.description: With the preparations done, new institutions of learning constructed and educators trained, the time to truly embrace our choice has come. Never again will Aquileian be taught in any institution of learning as a "native" language, from now on Herzlander is the native language of the inhabitants of our realm. While many will rant and rave, we cannot allow ourselves to remain behind the times.
records.brief: A standard school reader beside aligned classroom slates, a displaced alternative textbook closed below.

records.name: Adopt Imperial Drill
records.description: As our great house is aligning itself with the beating heart of Griffonia, we should not only look into their language, but also into what advancements they have made. The Griffonian Empire, the leader of the Heartlands, has been greatly expanding their armed forces and there is much we could learn from their offensive doctrine. And lucky for us, there are officers willing to share their knowledge.
records.brief: An offensive drill sand table with forward-moving formation blocks and an instructor's baton.

records.name: Adopt Aquileian Drill
records.description: As we are returning to our roots, it only makes sense for us to follow Aquileia in other ways. And the Aquileians have been making great advancements in military sphere. The most notable of these is the idea of a large and organized "Grande Armée". While we can't field a large army, we can field a perfectly organized one. And it seems that there are quite a few Aquileian commanders wiling to help us.
records.brief: An orderly regiment layout on a drill board beside a metronome and aligned equipment racks.

records.name: Avian Welfare Act
records.description: Let's give our citizens the help they need in order to survive. Basic Welfare will be institute for all impoverished griffons needing assistance. This should not only reduce poverty, but better stabilize our nation.
records.brief: A welfare basket of bread and medicine under an opened public-service window.

records.name: Legislate Agrarian Reform
records.description: What's better for Avian is to make sure our farmers get more support. Agriculture makes up the backbone of this country. We cannot forget the roots of our nation come from the soil that was tilled.
records.brief: A repaired plough beside surveyed field boundaries and a seed sack.

records.name: Implement Urbanisation Policies
records.description: The future lies with industry. We need to encourage more farmers to work in factories, to consider switching to urban life to strengthen our economy as well as the prosperity of our people. Urbanization is the way.
records.brief: A farm cart approaching newly built workers' housing and a factory chimney.

records.name: Every Village a Manufactory
records.description: Every village at least needs a small manufactory. We will make sure our initivative to help villages get a little industrial production is a success in order to make villages more self-sufficient.
records.brief: A village millhouse fitted with a small belt-driven machine visible through its open door.

records.name: Aviaire Alloys
records.description: New mining techniques have allowed for better use of our resources, and thus we have more resources to use for our industries thanks to new alloys.
records.brief: A glowing alloy crucible pouring into an ingot mould beside mineral samples.

records.name: Agricultural Mechanisation
records.description: The days of using mainly hoes and sickles have come to an end. It's time for the age of the tractor to reach Avian.
records.brief: A tractor wheel dominating a furrowed field, an old hoe laid aside.

records.name: Bolster Welfare Funding
records.description: We should expand our welfare system in order to satiate more of our impoverished griffons. Stronger welfare system means more love from griffons in struggle.
records.brief: A larger public relief chest supplying two filled food baskets.

records.name: Finalise Industrialisation
records.description: It's time we finalize our industrialization in order for our nation to compete with our neighbors economically and strengthen our military capabilities. Our country will finally be a modern society.
records.brief: A completed factory powerhouse with an operating flywheel and orderly loading yard.

records.name: Instate the Avian National Armoury
records.description: A national armoury must be created in order to facilitate the distribution of guns in an orderly manner to our militias and citizengriffs. In the case of war, a central Armoury will help organize the equipping process for our fighting force.
records.brief: A central armoury entrance with a distribution hatch and neatly counted rifle crates.

records.name: Support Avian Industry
records.description: Avian industry needs more economic funds in order to prosper. We should invest more in order for Avian to compete more in the manufacturing sector.
records.brief: A factory press receiving investment coins through a small funding tray.

records.name: The Hallhaus Aerodrome
records.description: Currently, we not have much space to commit to air operations with any aircraft, whether commercial or military. In order to fix this, we should build an aerodrome to help our store aircraft in order to create a larger air force.
records.brief: A broad aircraft hangar opening onto an aerodrome apron with a parked plane.

records.name: The University of Lishill
records.description: The University of Lishill will be established to educate a new generation of young Avaire griffons in new modern skills that can help us bring new research for our country, as well as bring in more skilled workers.
records.brief: A university arch framing an electrical teaching instrument and a diagrammed mechanics book.

records.name: Expand the Aviaire Metalworks
records.description: With our current economic growth, we now have an opportunity to expand our metalworks in order to accomodate our growing industrialization. Let's commit to that.
records.brief: An expanded rolling mill with a second roller pair and a stack of fresh metal plates.

records.name: Land Clearances
records.description: Even though we have a bunch of tenants on farms on the outskirts of Aviaire cities, we must evict them and clear out that space in order to expand our agricultural sector. After they are evicted, we can move them to a new sector.
records.brief: A tenant's packed household chest beside uprooted fence posts and a survey stake; show displacement, not vacant land.

records.name: Build the Lishill Oil Refinery
records.description: Oil is in such shortage for our burgeoning industrial state. We must build this refinery in the growing city of Lishill in order to shore up our oil deficiencies for both our civilian economy and military.
records.brief: An oil distillation tower with connecting pipes and a filled fuel drum.

records.name: Finalise Education Reform
records.description: With the university established, we can now optimize our education system so we can direct some griffons to go to the university in order to better their skills and literacy.
records.brief: A sequence of school primer, technical textbook and laboratory instrument, an organised education pathway.

records.name: The Communists Win
records.description: The revolution has succeeded! The reactionaries have either fled or been executed by our glorious Chairgriffon Redtail. With our victory, we can now work towards making our dreams of workers paradise a reality. The people can now reap the spoils against the bourgeoius scum.
records.brief: A crimson revolutionary banner above a broken aristocratic gate lock; no human revolutionary or invented party crest.

records.name: The Strong Arm of the Revolution
records.description: The People's Aviaire Army must be formed and more griffons conscripted. With our victory, reactionaries and bourgeois neighbors will come knocking out our door in an attempt to destroy our paradise. Let's make sure we have enough bodies to fill our borders.
records.brief: A new army rifle rack beneath a crimson recruitment pennant and a muster drum.

approved_visual_override.subject: A closed khaki service backpack standing beside a red-sided muster drum. No weapons. Khaki canvas, burgundy painted wood, dark iron.
approved_visual_override.note: Approved neutral artwork supersedes the prior visual composition only; original description, target pins and gameplay are unchanged.

records.name: A Socialist Economic System
records.description: Capitalism will be abolished. All property belongs to the state, and by extension: the people. We must make sure to redistribute fairly and equally in order for the masses to be happy. No more wealth will concentrate to the highest of aristocrats.
records.brief: A private strongbox opened into evenly divided public supply bins.

records.name: The Long Arm of the Revolution
records.description: Even with the people achieving victory, there is still plenty of subversive agents ready to try and dismantle our paradise from within. We must reform the original Triparte Intelligence Agency into a vanguard to make sure our populace does not waver from liberal and reactionary lies.
records.brief: A surveillance receiver looming over a locked correspondence cabinet tied with crimson cord.

records.name: Avian Collectivism
records.description: No more private farmers. Those farmers are basically small aristocrats anyways. All farmland will be collectivized and owned by the people and farmed fairly. All resources will be shared to make sure no one goes hungry.
records.brief: Field fences removed around one collective granary and shared agricultural tools.

records.name: A Socialist Education System
records.description: Every Aviaire griffon will be given a red book and be required to read at least 5 pages a day. If they cannot read because of illiteracy, they will have those words recited by loyal party members to make sure they understand the glories of socialism and why socialism is the only way forward.
records.brief: A crimson lesson book open to an illustrated factory lesson beside a reading lamp.

records.name: Socialist Technocracy
records.description: We did it. Our socialist paradise is complete in formation. We can now progress beyond in science unparalleled as our people receive the nourishment they need and the learning they receive from our institutions. Let the worker have his spoils.
records.brief: A laboratory control console backed by a communal grain bin and a technical instrument.

records.name: The Loyalists Win
records.description: It's over, we defeated our foes and have saved Avian from tyranny and ruin. With our victory complete, we can now reform the political system of Avian to be a system worth participating in for the people.
records.brief: A battered civic gate reopened beside a ballot box and a sheathed loyalist sword.

records.name: Purging the Army
records.description: The army must never get involved in Aviaire politics ever again. The army would only be a destructive tumor that will lead our country to only war and misery.
records.brief: An officer's sword removed from a civilian meeting desk and secured in a barracks rack.

records.name: Purging the Aristocracy
records.description: The landed elite have had its parasitic prosperity for far too long. It's time we bring an end to it and only allow wealth from those that work for it and not just inherit it.
records.brief: A hereditary estate key broken beside a working craftsperson's tool chest.

records.name: Liberalise the Government
records.description: The old government was hereditary, authoritarian, archaic, and broken. This old government must be broken and reformed into a liberal democracy. This democracy will allow for new blood and new ideas to sprout.
records.brief: An old locked government door replaced by an open parliamentary entrance and a ballot box.

records.name: Support Harmonic Institutions
records.description: In order for Avian to remain a democracy, we need to foster haromonic institutions that espouse liberty, freedom, and justice for all. A new judiciary is a must, along with a new legislative body in order to foster civic participation.
records.brief: A courthouse portico with balanced scales and a small elected assembly bench.

records.name: Promote Civic Freedoms
records.description: Every citizen of this country deserves their civic freedoms. We will give them freedom of speech, assembly, faith, and freedom of press. These four freedoms will be mandated in our new and fledging constitution.
records.brief: An unlocked printing press with an open speaking trumpet and a civic meeting bell.

records.name: Permit Local Elections
records.description: It's time we now officially allow local elections in order to begin civic participation amongst our citizens and foster a new citizen that is aware, active, and kind to their fellow brothers and sisters of our nation.
records.brief: A village ballot box receiving a clearly marked ballot, with a modest town-hall roof behind.

records.name: The Coup Succeeds
records.description: Our glorious leader Zypressen has won against both the Federalists and leftist technocrats wishing to ruin our great state. With victory achieved, we can now work towards fully consolidating Avian into a militarized state prepared for war to form a greater Verenia.
records.brief: A military baton laid across a seized government key beneath a plain crimson drape.

records.name: Purging the Army
records.description: Although it was his allies within the armed forces of House Avian that backed him during his coup and put him on the Avian throne, there are still elements of the army that remain loyal to the House and the departed Lady Avian, not to mention rival cliques in the military. Only by liquidating all opposition within the armed forces can the Lieutenant-General solidify his rule.
records.brief: An officer's sword rack with rival blades removed and broken command cords below.

records.name: Purging the Aristocracy
records.description: The aristocracy have been a thorn in our side for far too long. We must scour this country, purge every single noble. We don't need their decadent behavior to be tolerated anymore.
records.brief: A row of estate keys confiscated into a military lockbox.

records.name: Adopt the Stahlhaube
records.description: We need new helmets that are capable of more easily stopping bullets from downing our troops. The Stalhaube is an excellent helmet to make standard-issue for our troops. Along with that helmet, we should also make sure to give soldiers the basic shovel and binoculars as well to be more effective.
records.brief: A griffon-fitted Stahlhaube helmet dominating the icon, with a shovel and binoculars beneath.

records.name: Reintegrate Haustruppen Auxiliaries
records.description: The Haustruppen Auxillaries must be re-integrated because our army is one army only now. All troops will be fighting under one banner, under one army, and one unit in order to more effectively defeat our enemies.
records.brief: Separate auxiliary cartridge belts fastened into a single common equipment rack.

records.name: Reform Military Organisation Structure
records.description: Our military needs new restructuring. No more will we have archaic structures that the aristocracy created to simply keep their peasants in line. The military structure will be modern and organized by merit.
records.brief: A command telephone switchboard with short, orderly connections replacing tangled leads.

records.name: Restructure the Secret Service
records.description: The original Triparte Secret Service was a good start to a needed organization to protect against foreign spies but now it must be remade and made sure to not only watch for foreign subversives but domestic subversives as well who wish to weaken the integrity of our state.
records.brief: A locked security filing cabinet with a listening receiver and a lens over internal routes.

records.name: Restructure the Ministry of Economics
records.description: The Ministry of Economics needs massive restructuring in order for it to handle our militarized state. It needs to be repurposed for our neverending rearmament was we prepare to manufacture as many weapons as possible.
records.brief: An economic allocation wheel feeding metal stock directly into a shell-making press.

approved_visual_override.subject: A green industrial allocation ledger beside a balance carrying two small iron ingots. Muted green binding, ivory pages, pewter balance and charcoal iron.
approved_visual_override.note: Approved neutral artwork supersedes the prior visual composition only; original description, target pins and gameplay are unchanged.

records.name: Restructure the War Office
records.description: The War Office's original purpose was to prepare for defense against our enemies. But defense is weakness. We must be prepared to invade and secure our safety through war, and thus our office will be repurposed for mass conscription for such use.
records.brief: A mobilisation bell above a full kit depot and outward campaign route markers.

records.name: Strengthen Military Rule
records.description: The Aviaire people need to be reminded that the military is the biggest reason our country has stayed safe. We must keep it that way and for that to happen, we will use commit to mass military parades to show the people our strength.
records.brief: Parallel ranks of unattended service rifles beneath a parade drum and command baton.

records.name: Artillery Improvement Effort
records.description: Our army needs to prioritize artillery. The better artillery we have, the better we can pummel infantry and break their lines.
records.brief: A field howitzer with an improved recoil mechanism and a single heavy shell.

records.name: Armour Improvement Effort
records.description: Tanks are the future of warfare. We need to invest in a future that will be filled with these gigantic machines pummeling our enemy into the dirt.
records.brief: A heavy tank track and reinforced turret on a test platform.

records.name: Societal Improvement Effort
records.description: Along with how our military functions, our society must be in full cohesion with the military. Every single person will be a cog, united and strong, to fight our enemies.
records.brief: A workshop clock mechanically linked to a military supply conveyor.

records.name: Motorised Improvement Effort
records.description: The use of motorized cavalry can potentially change Avaiare warfare for our good. Motorized forces can outmaneuver so many units.
records.brief: A fast military truck beside a sweeping road-turn marker and a fuel can.

records.name: Mechanised Improvement Effort
records.description: Let's work on improving our mechanized forces and make them faster, stronger, and more able to fight more rapidly against our enemies.
records.brief: An armoured half-track with its protected troop compartment and driven tracks prominent.

records.name: Declare the Kingdom
records.description: The Kingdom is formed! It is time we retake our rightful place in Griffonia and make our neighbors bend to their knees in the awe of our realm.
records.brief: An elevated vacant royal throne beneath a plain state drape; no invented crown design or arms.

records.name: Reclaim Griffonstone
records.description: The heart and soul of the griffon belongs to us. We are the true inheritors of the old and it is time we retake our rightful place against the likes of old Gruff and his terrible rule.
records.brief: A siege ladder leaning toward a ruined ancestral stone citadel, marking a claim on Griffonstone.

records.name: Reclaim Flowena
records.description: The Bank of Griffonia is ours! How long have the merchants and noble houses of Flowena squandered the potential of its city through parties and decadence. No more, it's time for us to save it.
records.brief: A fortified bank vault with a campaign sword across its threshold, the claim on Flowena.

records.name: Reclaim Pomovarra
records.description: Pomovarra will be ours now. This minor land needs to be conquered and established as a part of our glorious kingdom in order for them to prosper.
records.brief: A small walled settlement approached by a military route arrow, the claim on Pomovarra.

records.name: Reclaim Adelart
records.description: Merlock Wood and his merry bandits have been plaguing the Adelart lands for far too long. It's time we arrest these hooligans and re-establish order in adelart.
records.brief: A woodland roadblock dismantled beside confiscated weapons, the campaign against Adelart's bandits.

records.name: Form the Archduchy
records.description: The Archduchy will be formed in order to protect the lands of the people and establish a new peace within those lands.
records.brief: An archducal administrative seat linking several district gates by roads; no fabricated coronet.

records.name: Integrate Copperhill
records.description: We must make sure we let the citizens now that they are safe under our rule. The people of Copperhill will come to love us.
records.brief: A Copperhill civic gate opened beside a service key and a repaired street lamp.

records.name: Reinstate the Kingdom
records.description: With the likes of corrupt Gruff off the beautiful ancestral homeland of Griffonstone, we can now reform ourselves into a new and improved Kingdom of Griffonstone under a dynasty worth its blood and soil.
records.brief: A restored ancestral stone hall with a newly repaired throne dais; no invented Griffonstone heraldry.

records.name: A Zypressen on the Imperial Throne
records.description: Whose to say a Zypressen isn't worthy of the Imperial Throne? The past decades have been filled with failure by the dynasty of Grovers that failed to keep Griffonia stable and prosperous due to their own incompetence and weak health. Fresh blood is needed now.
records.brief: A military sword resting across the vacant imperial throne, a contested Zypressen claim rather than Grover's regalia.
records.lore_notes: Creates a war goal; the throne is an objective, not an accomplished imperial coronation. Do not borrow Grover's personal regalia.

records.name: The Foundation Welcomed
records.description: We now have a new foundation for military strength, let's build upon that foundation for success.
records.brief: A guarded facility key laid beside a laboratory case, admitting the Foundation without inventing its insignia.
records.lore_notes: Keep the Foundation visually anonymous. No invented containment-agency emblem, named anomaly, or imported franchise logo.

records.name: Establish Secure Facilities
records.description: We need new facilities for our military to be successful. Let's make these facilities to better safeguard the nation.
records.brief: A reinforced laboratory door with two locking bars and a shielded observation window.

records.name: Form Mobile Task Forces
records.description: Modern militaries need faster responses to crisis in order to effectively protect the nation, we can form mobile task forces to respond more rapidly to crisis.
records.brief: A rapid-response truck with a portable radio and sealed equipment container.

records.name: Centralise Foundation Control
records.description: Now with the Foundation established, let's centralize control in order to better strengthen our military and make it more efficient.
records.brief: A central control console joining three facility indicator circuits.

records.name: Reassemble Foundation Personnel
records.description: We need top personnel as soon as possible! Let's quicken our recruiting process to get more skilled people into the Foundation.
records.brief: A specialist's instrument case beside a recruitment desk bell and a laboratory access key.

records.name: Relocate Foundation Laboratories
records.description: Current laboratories are unsafe and insecure. We need to relocate our facilities to more secure locations that are less likely to be found and attacked.
records.brief: A microscope packed in a shock-proof transport crate beside a guarded relocation route.

records.name: Foundation Scientific Expansion
records.description: Research must be expanded in order to find new discoveries for our military to exploit. We must expand our pool of scientists and engineers for the good of our country.
records.brief: A newly expanded laboratory bench with a spectrometer and additional specimen rack.

records.name: Foundation Infrastructure Expansion
records.description: In order to strengthen our network, we need more infrastructure, roads that connect our facilities and makes it easier for scientists to move between facilities, as well as troops.
records.brief: A service road linking a laboratory building to a guarded facility entrance.

records.name: Foundation Military Expansion
records.description: The more soldiers to protect our facilities the better. Let's make sure we have the skilled military troops needed to protect the work we created.
records.brief: A facility guard post with a service rifle and protected scientific equipment crate.
